name: cursor-auto-runner
description: System-tray app that automatically clicks the Run / Always Run button in the Cursor IDE and tracks click statistics.
author: KurtStevenK <kurt.steven.kainzmayer@gmail.com>

scripts.compile: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.overlay.json && node scripts/copy-overlay-assets.js
scripts.dist:mac: npm run compile && electron-builder --mac --publish never && node scripts/rename-mac-dmg-artifacts.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile && TEST_TIMING_SCALE=4 node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='dist/src/**' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/main.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/detector.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/tray.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/updates.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/capture.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/button-test.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/permissions.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/mac-*.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/*preload.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/clicker.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/match-worker-client.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/native-image-bgra.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/template-loader.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/main/perf.js' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/src/overlay/**' --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-branches=70 dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.build:firebase-landing: node scripts/sync-firebase-release-data.js && npm run build --prefix firebase-landing
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build:firebase-landing && firebase deploy --only hosting,storage --project cursor-auto-runner-linux

extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Cursor Auto Runner watches the screen to find the Run button in your Cursor IDE window.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: Cursor Auto Runner needs accessibility access to click the Run button for you.
